description.value: OEB Breakfast Co. is a chef-driven Canadian breakfast and brunch chain founded in Calgary in 2009 by classically trained Chef Mauro Martina, built on a farm-to-table philosophy emphasizing locally sourced Canadian ingredients. The Langley location is part of a growing national network, serving inventive dishes such as breakfast poutines, chef-crafted eggs bennies, and bold blue plate specials alongside familiar classics. OSM records outdoor seating at this location, offering a comfortable al fresco option for cyclists looking to fuel up on a ride through the Fraser Valley.
